speeeh bubble & dialogs should be above all else --- zindex issue

I’ll trace the dialog and speech-bubble stacking rules, then make the smallest z-index fix and verify the affected UI behavior. I’m using the repo’s `using-entire` workflow because this is a codebase exploration task and it can surface the original intent behind the layering.

input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"sed -n '1,240p' /home/pjensen/.codex/RTK.md && sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/using-entire/SKILL.md","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk entire status && rtk rg -n \"speech|bubble|dialog|z-index|zIndex\" src index.html --glob '!src/lib/**'","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk sed -n '1,230p' src/display/ui/bubbleDialog.js && rtk sed -n '1,150p' src/display/ui/overlay.js && rtk sed -n '400,465p' src/main.js && rtk sed -n '70,115p' index.html && rtk git log --format='%H%n%B' -5 -- src/display/ui/bubbleDialog.js src/display/ui/overlay.js","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk rg -n \"function ensureRoot|function ensurePanel|PANEL_Z|overlay-root|speech-bubble-dialog\" src/display/ui tests && rtk git log --format='%H %s%n%b' -10 -- src/display/ui/bubbleDialog.js && rtk entire explain --checkpoint a1b5d44da406 --json --no-pager","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

content.text: The issue is concrete: the interactive speech bubble is at z-index 90, while ordinary HUD and overlay panels range from roughly 900 to 1,400—and the sleep popup reaches 12,000. I’m checking the panel focus logic and existing tests now so the fix covers both bubble dialogs and full-screen dialog overlays without creating an inconsistent stack.

input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk sed -n '140,185p' src/display/ui/overlayUtils.js && rtk sed -n '1225,1300p' src/display/ui/overlayUtils.js && rtk sed -n '760,850p' src/display/ui/overlay.js && rtk sed -n '1,150p' src/display/ui/dialogOverlay.js && rtk sed -n '1,180p' tests/dialogAndCharacterKeyboard.test.mjs && rtk rg -n \"zIndex:\\s*['\\\"]?[0-9]{4,}|z-index:\\s*[0-9]{4,}\" src index.html --glob '!src/lib/**'","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk rg -n \"initOverlays\\(|ui:openDialog|ui-root|PANEL_Z_BASE\" tests --glob '*.mjs'","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk sed -n '1,70p' src/main/wiring/dialogWiring.js && rtk sed -n '210,320p' src/display/ui/bubbleDialog.js","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"rtk git diff -- src/display/ui/overlayUtils.js src/display/ui/bubbleDialog.js src/display/ui/overlay.js tests/dialogAndCharacterKeyboard.test.mjs && rtk deno test --allow-read tests/dialogAndCharacterKeyboard.test.mjs","workdir":"/home/pjensen/Repos/JSHack","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output);

content.text: The stacking fix is in place: speech-bubble pieces now share a dedicated top layer, and opening a full dialog temporarily elevates the UI root to that same layer, restoring it when the dialog closes. The focused dialog tests pass; I’m running the repository guardrails to catch import or architecture regressions.

Fixed the z-index issue.

- Speech bubbles, connectors, and speaker dots now use a dedicated top layer (`20000+`).
- Full dialog overlays elevate the UI root while open, then restore it when closed.
- Added stacking regression coverage.
